questions.question: A ladder 10 metres long leans against a wall making an angle of 60° with the ground. Find the height (in metres) of the wall the ladder reaches.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a 30°-60°-90° right-angled triangle, the ratio of sides opposite to the angles is 1 : √3 : 2.

The hypotenuse (the ladder, opposite to 90°) represents 2 parts = 10 m.

⇒ 1 part = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 m.

The height of the wall (opposite to 60°) represents √3 parts.

⇒ Height of wall = 5 × √3 = 5√3 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 5√3 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
• 
 60° 10 m h = ? Ground Wall 

**Given:**

Length of the ladder (Hypotenuse) = 10 m

Angle of elevation with the ground (θ) = 60°

**Formula Used:**

sin θ = Perpendicular ÷ Hypotenuse

**Calculations:**

Let the height of the wall the ladder reaches be 'h' metres.

⇒ sin 60° = h ÷ 10

⇒ √3 ÷ 2 = h ÷ 10

⇒ h = 10 × (√3 ÷ 2)

⇒ h = 5√3 m

**∴ The correct answer is 5√3 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

In a right-angled triangle: sin θ = Perpendicular ÷ Hypotenuse, cos θ = Base ÷ Hypotenuse, and tan θ = Perpendicular ÷ Base.

Standard Angle Values

Important sine values frequently used: sin 30° = 1 ÷ 2, sin 45° = 1 ÷ √2, and sin 60° = √3 ÷ 2.

Pythagoras Theorem

The square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: H² = P² + B².

Angles of Elevation and Depression

The angle of elevation is formed when looking upward from a horizontal line, while the angle of depression is formed when looking downward. They represent alternate interior angles and are always equal.

questions.question: What is the greatest volume container (in litres) that can measure 300 litres, 280 litres and 180 litres.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The greatest capacity container required to measure the given quantities exactly is the HCF of the given volumes.

Find the smallest difference between any two volumes: 300 − 280 = 20.

The HCF must be either this smallest difference or a factor of it.

Since 20 perfectly divides all three volumes (300 ÷ 20 = 15, 280 ÷ 20 = 14, 180 ÷ 20 = 9), the HCF is 20.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volumes to be measured = 300 litres, 280 litres, and 180 litres.

**Method Used:**

To find the greatest volume container that can measure all the quantities in exact number of times, we need to calculate the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of the three given volumes.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Prime factorisation of 300 = 2² × 3 × 5²

⇒ Prime factorisation of 280 = 2³ × 5 × 7

⇒ Prime factorisation of 180 = 2² × 3² × 5

⇒ The common prime factors among all three are 2 and 5.

⇒ HCF = Product of common prime factors with their lowest powers

⇒ HCF = 2² × 5¹

⇒ HCF = 4 × 5 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

The HCF of two or more numbers is the greatest number that divides each of them exactly without leaving any remainder. It is also known as the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD).

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The LCM of two or more numbers is the smallest number which is perfectly divisible by each of the given numbers.

Difference Method for HCF

The HCF of given numbers is always either the smallest difference between any two of the numbers or a factor of that difference. This method is highly effective for quickly finding the HCF in competitive exams.
</p

47, 51, 51, 48, 53, 54, 47, 52, 51, 46, 43, 47, 52, 40, 47, 41, 43, 43, 46, 47

The mode is simply the observation that appears the maximum number of times in a given data set.

By quickly scanning the given data, we can tally the frequency of the most repeated numbers.

The number 47 appears 5 times, while no other number appears more than 3 times.

**∴ The correct answer is 47.**

Mean

The arithmetic average of a set of numbers. It is calculated as: Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations.

Median

The middle value of a sorted data set. For 'n' odd terms, Median = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term. For 'n' even terms, it is the average of the (n ÷ 2)th and ((n ÷ 2) + 1)th terms.

Empirical Relationship

A statistical rule that connects the three major measures of central tendency for a moderately skewed distribution: Mode ≈ 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
</p

questions.question: The fourth proportional to 20, 15 and 8 is the same as the third proportional to A and 30. What is the value of A?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Fourth proportional to 20, 15, and 8 = (15 × 8) ÷ 20 = 6

Third proportional to A and 30 = 30² ÷ A = 900 ÷ A

Since both are equal:

900 ÷ A = 6 ⇒ A = 900 ÷ 6 = 150

**∴ The correct answer is 150.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three numbers for the fourth proportional = 20, 15, and 8

Two numbers for the third proportional = A and 30

**Formula Used:**

Fourth proportional x of a, b, c is: a : b :: c : x ⇒ x = (b × c) ÷ a

Third proportional y of a, b is: a : b :: b : y ⇒ y = b² ÷ a

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Fourth Proportional
 20 : 15 :: 8 : x
 x = 6
 
 Third Proportional
 A : 30 :: 30 : 6
 A = 150
 

 
 A = 150

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the fourth proportional to 20, 15 and 8 be x.

⇒ 20 : 15 :: 8 : x

⇒ 20 × x = 15 × 8

⇒ 20x = 120

⇒ x = 6

⇒ Given that the third proportional to A and 30 is equal to the fourth proportional (which is 6).

⇒ A : 30 :: 30 : 6

⇒ A × 6 = 30 × 30

⇒ 6A = 900

⇒ A = 150

**∴ The correct answer is 150.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

Third Proportional

If y is the third proportional to a and b, then a : b :: b : y ⇒ y = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

If x is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c, then a : b :: c : x ⇒ x = (b × c) ÷ a.

Compound Ratio

For two ratios a : b and c : d, their compound ratio is (a × c) : (b × d).
</p

questions.question: For 6 innings, a cricketer had an average of 100 runs. In the 7th inning, he scored 235 runs. His average score increased by ______. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ Total runs in 6 innings = 6 × 100 = 600

⇒ After 7th inning: total = 600 + 235 = 835

⇒ New average = 835 ÷ 7 ≈ 119.29

⇒ Increase = 119.29 − 100 = 19.29 ≈ 19

**∴ Answer = 19**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Average for 6 innings = 100

⇒ Score in 7th inning = 235

**Formula:**

⇒ Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 6 innings = 6 × 100 = 600

⇒ Total runs in 7 innings = 600 + 235 = 835

⇒ New average = 835 ÷ 7 = 119.29

⇒ Increase = 119.29 − 100 = 19.29

⇒ Rounded value = 19

**∴ Final Answer: 19**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**1. Average Formula:** Total ÷ Number

**2. Total from Average:** Average × Count

**3. Increment Concept:** Compare new and old average

**4. Tip:** Always compute total first

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 44°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 5 : 6, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Property: If bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral intersect, the angle formed is exactly half the sum of the other two angles.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 2 × ∠STR = 2 × 44° = 88°

Given the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 5 : 6, the total sum represents 11 parts.

⇒ 11 parts = 88° ⇒ 1 part = 8°

⇒ Difference (∠Q − ∠P) = 6 parts − 5 parts = 1 part = 8°.

**∴ The correct answer is 8°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠STR = 44°

∠P : ∠Q = 5 : 6

**Calculations:**

In ΔTSR, the sum of all interior angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠STR + ∠TSR + ∠TRS = 180°

Since ST and RT are the angle bisectors of ∠S and ∠R respectively:

⇒ 44° + (∠S ÷ 2) + (∠R ÷ 2) = 180°

⇒ (∠S + ∠R) ÷ 2 = 180° − 44° = 136°

⇒ ∠S + ∠R = 272°

In quadrilateral PQRS, the sum of all interior angles is 360°.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + 272° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 88°

Let ∠P = 5x and ∠Q = 6x based on the given ratio.

⇒ 5x + 6x = 88°

⇒ 11x = 88° ⇒ x = 8°

We need the difference between ∠Q and ∠P:

⇒ ∠Q − ∠P = 6x − 5x = x = 8°

**∴ The correct answer is 8°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is always 360°. The general formula for a polygon with n sides is (n − 2) × 180°.

Angle Bisector Theorem in Quadrilaterals

If bisectors of any two adjacent angles intersect inside the quadrilateral, the angle formed at their intersection is exactly half the sum of the remaining two non-bisected angles.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

If a quadrilateral is inscribed within a circle, the sum of its opposite angles is supplementary (exactly equal to 180°).

questions.question: ₹1,411 is divided among Pooja, Harsh and Madhur in such a way that if ₹12, ₹23 and ₹43 are deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 21:16:6. Find the actual share of Harsh.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let shares after deduction = 21x : 16x : 6x

Original ⇒ (21x+12) + (16x+23) + (6x+43) = 1411

43x + 78 = 1411 ⇒ x = 31

Harsh = 16x + 23 = 496 + 23 = 519

**∴ Answer = ₹519**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = 1411

Deductions: 12, 23, 43

Ratio after deduction = 21 : 16 : 6

**Formula used:**

If values are in ratio a : b : c ⇒ actual = ax, bx, cx

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let reduced shares = 21x, 16x, 6x

⇒ Original shares:

Pooja = 21x + 12

Harsh = 16x + 23

Madhur = 6x + 43

⇒ Total = (21x+12)+(16x+23)+(6x+43)

⇒ = 43x + 78 = 1411

⇒ 43x = 1333

⇒ x = 31

⇒ Harsh = 16x + 23

⇒ = 16×31 + 23

⇒ = 496 + 23 = 519

**∴ The correct answer is ₹519.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Adjusted Ratio

Use ratio after deduction first

questions.question: The product of two numbers is 96 and their sum is 20. Find the value of the square of their difference.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

(a − b)² = (a + b)² − 4ab

= 20² − 4 × 96

= 400 − 384 = 16

**∴ Answer = 16**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Product of two numbers = 96

Sum of two numbers = 20

**Formula used:**

(a − b)² = (a + b)² − 4ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let numbers be a and b

⇒ a + b = 20

⇒ ab = 96

⇒ (a − b)² = (20)² − 4 × 96

⇒ = 400 − 384

⇒ = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity Used

(a − b)² = (a + b)² − 4ab

Shortcut Tip

Use sum and product directly

Algebraic Concept

Useful for symmetric expressions

questions.question: The monthly incomes of two friends David and Ashish, are in the ratio 5 : 9, respectively, and each of them saves ₹39,000 every month. If the ratio of their monthly expenditure is 2 : 4, find the monthly income of David (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equal savings ⇒ Income − Expenditure is same

Let incomes = 5x and 9x

Let expenditures = 2y and 4y

So, 5x − 2y = 39000 and 9x − 4y = 39000

Subtract ⇒ 4x − 2y = 0 ⇒ 2x = y

Put y = 2x ⇒ 5x − 4x = 39000 ⇒ x = 39000

**∴ Answer = 195000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income ratio = 5 : 9, Expenditure ratio = 2 : 4, Savings = 39000 each

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let income = 5x and 9x

⇒ Let expenditure = 2y and 4y

⇒ 5x − 2y = 39000 ...(1)

⇒ 9x − 4y = 39000 ...(2)

⇒ (2) − (1): 4x − 2y = 0

⇒ 2x = y

⇒ Substitute in (1): 5x − 4x = 39000

⇒ x = 39000

⇒ David's income = 5x = 5 × 39000 = 195000

**∴ The correct answer is 195000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income–Expenditure Relation

Savings = Income − Expenditure. If savings are equal, differences in income equal differences in expenditure.

Ratio Concept

If quantities are in ratio a : b, they can be written as ax and bx respectively.

Linear Equations

Two equations can be solved using substitution or elimination method.

Shortcut Insight

When savings are equal, subtract equations to quickly eliminate constants and find relation between variables.

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods at 40% above the cost price. He then offers a discount of 20% on the marked price. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive change formula: Net % = a − b − (a × b)/100

Here, a = +40, b = 20

Net % = 40 − 20 − (40 × 20)/100

= 20 − 8 = 12%

**∴ Answer = 12% profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 40% above Cost Price, Discount = 20%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price − Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Cost Price = 100

⇒ Marked Price = 100 + 40% of 100 = 140

⇒ Discount = 20% of 140 = 28

⇒ Selling Price = 140 − 28 = 112

⇒ Profit = 112 − 100 = 12

⇒ Profit % = (12/100) × 100 = 12%

**∴ The correct answer is 12%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price

Marked Price = Cost Price × (1 + Markup/100)

Discount Formula

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 − Discount/100)

Successive Percentage Change

Net change = a − b − (a × b)/100 when increase is followed by decrease

Profit Percentage

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) × 100

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹1,200 at 15% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of compound interest for 2 years at 15% p.a. = 15 + 15 + (15 × 15) ÷ 100 = 32.25%.

Total Amount % = Principal (100%) + Compound Interest (32.25%) = 132.25%.

Amount = 132.25% of ₹1200.

Amount = 132.25 × 12 = ₹1587.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1587.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1200

Rate (R) = 15% per annum

Time (n) = 2 years

questions.question: Find the number of bricks required to build a wall 20 m long, 9.9 m high and 30 cm thick, using bricks of size 25 cm × 11 cm × 8 cm, if 10% of the wall volume is filled with cement.
questions.solution:

Wall volume = 20 × 9.9 × 0.3 = 59.4 m³

Brick volume = 0.25 × 0.11 × 0.08 = 0.0022 m³

Only 90% is bricks ⇒ 59.4 × 0.9 = 53.46 m³

Number of bricks = 53.46 ÷ 0.0022 = 24300

**∴ Answer = 24300 bricks**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Wall: 20 m × 9.9 m × 30 cm, Brick: 25 cm × 11 cm × 8 cm, Cement = 10%

**Formula used:**

Number of bricks = (Volume of wall × % of bricks) ÷ Volume of one brick

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert thickness: 30 cm = 0.3 m

⇒ Volume of wall = 20 × 9.9 × 0.3 = 59.4 m³

⇒ Volume occupied by bricks = 90% of 59.4 = 53.46 m³

⇒ Volume of one brick = 0.25 × 0.11 × 0.08 = 0.0022 m³

⇒ Number of bricks = 53.46 ÷ 0.0022

⇒ Number of bricks = 24300

**∴ The correct answer is 24300 bricks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Concept

Volume = Length × Breadth × Height. Ensure same units before calculation.

Brickwork Adjustment

Usually 5–10% volume is mortar, so only remaining volume is bricks.

1 m = 100 cm, so convert all dimensions into meters before volume calculation.

Efficiency Trick

Directly multiply total volume by brick percentage to avoid extra subtraction steps.

questions.question: The marked price of a washing machine is ₹62,000. A shopkeeper allows a discount of 73% and gets a profit of 20%. What is the cost price of the washing machine?

After 73% discount ⇒ SP = 27% of MP

SP = 27% of 62000 = 16740

Profit = 20% ⇒ SP = 120% of CP

CP = 16740 ÷ 1.2 = 13950

**∴ Answer = 13950**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 62000, Discount = 73%, Profit = 20%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = MP × (1 − Discount/100), Profit % = (SP − CP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = 62000 × (27/100)

⇒ SP = 16740

⇒ Profit = 20% ⇒ SP = 1.2 × CP

⇒ CP = SP ÷ 1.2

⇒ CP = 16740 ÷ 1.2 = 13950

**∴ The correct answer is 13950.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Concept

Successive percentage changes can be solved quickly using multiplier method.

questions.question: A garrison of 1209 men has provisions for 24 days. How long (in days) will the provisions last if the garrison is increased by 403 men?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Men and days are inversely proportional

Total men after increase = 1209 + 403 = 1612

Days = (1209 × 24) ÷ 1612

Since 1612 = 1209 + 403 = (3 × 403) + 403 = 4 × 403 and 1209 = 3 × 403

Days = (3/4) × 24 = 18

**∴ Answer = 18 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial men = 1209, Days = 24, Increase = 403 men

**Formula used:**

Men × Days = Constant (inverse proportion)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total men after increase = 1209 + 403 = 1612

⇒ Let required days = x

⇒ 1209 × 24 = 1612 × x

⇒ x = (1209 × 24) ÷ 1612

⇒ x = (3 × 403 × 24) ÷ (4 × 403)

⇒ x = (3 × 24) ÷ 4

⇒ x = 72 ÷ 4 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

When one quantity increases, the other decreases such that their product remains constant.

Man-Days Concept

Total work or consumption = Number of men × number of days.

Shortcut Ratio

New days = Old days × (Old men / New men)

Simplification Trick

Break numbers into factors to cancel quickly and reduce calculation time.

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 9 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 36 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Total Work = LCM(9, 36) = 36 units

Efficiency of (P + Q) = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 units/hour

Efficiency of P = 36 ÷ 36 = 1 unit/hour

Efficiency of Q = 4 − 1 = 3 units/hour

Work = 1/4 of 36 = 9 units ⇒ Time = 9 ÷ 3 = 3 hours

**∴ Answer = 3 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

= 1620 × 72/100 = 1166.4

questions.question: Find a single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 22%, 8% and 17%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use successive discount formula stepwise

First combine 22% and 8% ⇒ 22 + 8 − (22 × 8)/100 = 30 − 1.76 = 28.24%

Now combine 28.24% and 17%

= 28.24 + 17 − (28.24 × 17)/100 ≈ 45.24 − 4.80 ≈ 40.44%

**∴ Answer ≈ 40.44%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Three successive discounts = 22%, 8%, 17%

⇒ Remaining after 8% = 92%

⇒ Remaining after 17% = 83%

⇒ Net remaining = 0.78 × 0.92 × 0.83

⇒ = 0.597 ≈ 59.66%

⇒ Equivalent discount = 100 − 59.66 = 40.44%

**∴ The correct answer is approximately 40.44%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive discounts reduce price multiplicatively, not additively.

questions.question: The age of T is 20 years more than the age of R. S's age is 10 years less than the age of P. P's age is half the age of R. The sum of ages of all is 130 years. What is the age of R in years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let R = x ⇒ P = x/2

S = x/2 − 10, T = x + 20

Total = x + (x + 20) + (x/2) + (x/2 − 10)

= 3x + 10 = 130 ⇒ 3x = 120

x = 40

**∴ Answer = 40**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

T = R + 20, P = R/2, S = P − 10, Total age = 130

**Formula used:**

Sum of all ages = R + T + P + S

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let age of R = x

⇒ T = x + 20

⇒ P = x/2

⇒ S = (x/2) − 10

⇒ Total = x + (x + 20) + (x/2) + (x/2 − 10)

⇒ = x + x + 20 + x/2 + x/2 − 10

⇒ = 3x + 10

⇒ 3x + 10 = 130

⇒ 3x = 120

⇒ x = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Denominator = 3⁽³x−⁹⁺³⁾ = 3⁽³x−⁶⁾

Final = 3⁽³x−⁴ − ⁽³x−⁶⁾⁾ = 3² = 9

**∴ Answer = 9**

(3⁽⁴⁺x⁾ × 9⁽x−⁴⁾) ÷ (27⁽x−³⁾ × 3³)

Index laws: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ, (am)ⁿ = amⁿ, am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ (3⁽⁴⁺x⁾ × (3²)⁽x−⁴⁾) ÷ ((3³)⁽x−³⁾ × 3³)

⇒ (3⁽⁴⁺x⁾ × 3⁽²x−⁸⁾) ÷ (3⁽³x−⁹⁾ × 3³)

⇒ 3⁽⁴⁺x⁺²x−⁸⁾ ÷ 3⁽³x−⁹⁺³⁾

⇒ 3⁽³x−⁴⁾ ÷ 3⁽³x−⁶⁾

⇒ 3⁽⁽³x−⁴⁾ − ⁽³x−⁶⁾⁾

⇒ 3²

⇒ 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

questions.question: Due to water crisis, 40% of the initial population left the village, and 10% of the remaining left the town for pursuing jobs. If presently, 1080 people inhabit the village, what is the ratio of the initial population to the present population?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

After 40% leave ⇒ 60% remain

Then 10% of remaining leave ⇒ 90% of 60% = 54%

So present population = 54% of initial

Ratio = Initial : Present = 100 : 54

= 50 : 27

**∴ Answer = 50 : 27**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

40% left initially, then 10% of remaining left, Present population = 1080

**Formula used:**

Remaining population = Initial × (1 − 40/100) × (1 − 10/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let initial population = x

⇒ After 40% leave ⇒ remaining = 0.6x

⇒ After 10% more leave ⇒ remaining = 0.6x × 0.9 = 0.54x

⇒ 0.54x = 1080

⇒ x = 1080 ÷ 0.54 = 2000

⇒ Ratio = Initial : Present = 2000 : 1080

⇒ = 50 : 27

**∴ The correct answer is 50 : 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Final value = Initial × (1 − a/100) × (1 − b/100)

Percentage to Ratio

If final = k% of initial, then ratio = 100 : k

Reverse Calculation

Initial = Final ÷ remaining fraction

Quick Insight

Successive decreases multiply, not add.

questions.question: A train of length 164 m takes 10 seconds to pass another train, 136 m long, coming from the opposite direction. If the speed of the first train is 82 { km/hr} , then find the speed of the second train.
questions.solution:

Total distance (opposite direction) = 164 + 136 = 300 m

Relative speed = 300 ÷ 10 = 30 m/s

Convert 30 m/s to km/hr ⇒ 30 × 18/5 = 108 km/hr

Second train speed = 108 − 82 = 26 km/hr

**∴ Answer = 26 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lengths = 164 m and 136 m, Time = 10 sec, Speed of first train = 82 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = (Sum of lengths) ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 164 + 136 = 300 m

⇒ Relative speed = 300 ÷ 10 = 30 m/s

⇒ Convert to km/hr ⇒ 30 × 18/5 = 108 km/hr

⇒ Let speed of second train = x

⇒ 82 + x = 108

⇒ x = 108 − 82 = 26 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 26 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

For opposite direction, relative speed = sum of individual speeds.

Train Crossing

Distance covered = sum of lengths when two trains cross each other.

Unit Conversion

1 m/s = 18/5 km/hr

Quick Trick

Find relative speed first, then subtract known speed.

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 45. One number is 5 more than the other. Find the larger number.

Difference = 5, Sum = 45

Larger number = (Sum + Difference) ÷ 2

= (45 + 5) ÷ 2 = 50 ÷ 2 = 25

**∴ Answer = 25**

**Given:**

Sum = 45, One number is 5 more than the other

**Formula used:**

Let smaller = x, larger = x + 5

**Calculation:**

⇒ x + (x + 5) = 45

⇒ 2x + 5 = 45

⇒ 2x = 40

⇒ x = 20

⇒ Larger number = x + 5 = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

Sum and Difference Formula

Linear Equation

Alternative View

Split total into equal parts and adjust using difference.
